<Update label="Week of July 28, 2026">

## New features

**Auto-generated SDK reference tabs!**

Ship SDK reference documentation straight from the tools your team already runs! Five languages are now wired up under v5.0, each rendered from a native doc-tool artifact:

- **TypeScript / JavaScript** — [TypeDoc](https://typedoc.org) JSON
- **Java** — [Javadoc](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/javadoc/javadoc.html) HTML
- **.NET** — [DocFX](https://dotnet.github.io/docfx/) ManagedReference YAML
- **Python** — [Sphinx](https://www.sphinx-doc.org) JSON builder output
- **PHP** — [phpDocumentor](https://phpdoc.org) `structure.xml`

Every class, interface, module, and function gets its own page — with navigation groups, cross-page links, and full search indexing — no hand-authored reference pages required! Start from the new [SDK reference setup guide](/essentials/sdk-reference-setup) to see how to point the `sdk` navigation property at your artifact.

**Preview deployments guide!**

A brand-new [preview deployments page](/essentials/preview-deployments) walks you through unique preview URLs for every pull request! Reviewers can click a shareable link and see docs changes live before anything merges to production — automatic via GitHub, manual from the dashboard, or programmatic via the Admin API.

## Updates

**Capybara species reference on the v3 roadmap!**

The [v3 product roadmap](/en/v3/roadmap) now includes side-by-side reference sections for the greater capybara (*Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris*) and the lesser capybara (*Hydrochoerus isthmius*), complete with size, range, and habitat details plus a quick comparison table to help you pick the right species for your project!

</Update>

<Update label="Week of July 21, 2026">

## New features

**Hidden page demos for search and AI context**

Three new hidden pages show how to keep supporting content out of the sidebar while still exposing it to site search and AI tools:

- [Writing style notes](/essentials/hidden-writing-style-notes) — a hidden page inside a searchable hidden group.
- [AI assistant context](/hidden-pages/ai-assistant-context) — a hidden page under a dedicated searchable hidden tab.
- [Internal scoring notes](/en/v2/tabs/install/hidden-internal-scoring-notes) — a hidden page accessible only by direct URL, kept out of search and AI indexing.

Each page illustrates a different pattern for using `hidden: true` alongside `searchable` settings so you can pick the right level of visibility for your content.

</Update>
